title: Two-stage exact behavioral retrieval with cached late-interaction reranking
question: Can a cheap behavioral retrieval stage remove the O(M*k) candidate-search bottleneck before cached learned compatibility reranking, while preserving capability on the registered G-CASM workload?
hypothesis: An exact public-behavior retrieval ceiling should remove candidates inconsistent with observed support at negligible logical query depth, after which cached 012 compatibility reranking can operate on a smaller candidate set without requiring per-query candidate encoding.

arms.name: exhaustive_behavioral
arms.intervention: cached 012 behavioral compatibility scorer over the complete M-sized prefix

arms.name: indexed_behavioral
arms.intervention: exact support-behavior bitmap retrieval followed by cached 012 reranking of the retrieved set
arms.acts_on: retrieval boundary plus cached late interaction

arms.name: index_only
arms.intervention: exact support-behavior bitmap retrieval followed by deterministic candidate order

arms.name: random
arms.intervention: seeded random candidate order without learned routing

endpoints.name: minimum_adaptive_execution_work_fraction_at_capability
endpoints.role: primary — minimum adaptive exact-execution work fraction at support_size=4 among budgets retaining >=0.80 exhaustive exact capability

endpoints.name: target_routing_recall
endpoints.role: secondary — target admission within execution budget

endpoints.name: target_rank
endpoints.role: secondary — target rank under the learned cached scorer

endpoints.name: candidates_scored
endpoints.role: secondary — learned reranker population actually scored

endpoints.name: query_macs
endpoints.role: secondary — learned reranker arithmetic before exact execution

endpoints.name: index_query_operations
endpoints.role: secondary — posting lookups and bitmap-word operations

held_constant: G-CASM-010 generator and pinned external generator commit
G-CASM-012 behavioral compatibility training objective and 256-program training pool
nested M prefixes of one fixed 512-program evaluation library per seed
four binary input variables and 16-row truth-table domain
support rows 4/8/12 with complementary verifier rows
seed-level bootstrap and raw per-seed trial data
leakage_rules: The learned reranker sees only candidate public features and observed support rows.
The exact index sees only public candidate truth-table metadata and the observed support rows.
Target identity is used only after ranking for evaluation metrics.
Verifier-only rows are never used in retrieval or reranking.
A single evaluation library and a single index are built before query evaluation within each seed.
No per-query index rebuilding, target-specific index construction, or post-measurement selection is permitted.
instrument_controls: exhaustive exact verification over the full M population
exact index equivalence against exhaustive support consistency
fixed-budget row-count invariant rows_evaluated = selected_candidate_count * verifier_rows
cached reranker score equivalence against uncached 012 scorer
train/evaluation structure and truth-table split assertions
candidate cache and behavioral index built once per seed

primary_endpoint.criterion: At each M, report the minimum adaptive exact-execution work fraction among registered budgets whose fixed-budget exact success is at least 0.80.

statistical_contract.primary_estimate: seed-level mean of the minimum-budget primary endpoint

decision_rule.condition: All benchmark, leakage, protocol, implementation, instrument, statistical and provenance gates pass.
decision_rule.licenses: the completed run is scientifically interpretable under the registered scope.
decision_rule.does_not_license: general semantic search, asymptotic sublinear scaling, or hardware speedup.

decision_rule.condition: indexed_behavioral retains >=0.80 exhaustive exact capability with lower adaptive execution work than exhaustive_behavioral.
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that a two-stage behavioral retrieval boundary improves selective execution on this finite-domain workload.
decision_rule.does_not_license: universal routing superiority or asymptotic C5.

decision_rule.condition: exact retrieval is capability-preserving but learned reranking remains unstable.
decision_rule.licenses: the routing bottleneck lies downstream of exact behavioral retrieval, motivating a separate learned late-interaction study.

decision_rule.condition: indexed_behavioral is exact but the combined index-plus-reranker arithmetic is not lower than exhaustive cached scoring.
decision_rule.licenses: the retrieval ceiling is semantically effective but not computationally decisive under the registered cost units.

decision_rule.condition: no budget reaches the capability floor.
decision_rule.licenses: the registered selective-execution criterion is not reached at that M.
